mapper.select: SELECT account.user_id AS user_id, account.account_id AS account_id, 'PRODUCT_TRANSACTION' AS reference_type, product_transaction.product_transaction_id AS reference_id, CASE product_transaction.type WHEN 'SUBSCRIBE' THEN 'JOIN_PRODUCTS' WHEN 'TERMINATE' THEN 'CANCEL_PRODUCTS' WHEN 'MATURITY' THEN 'MATURITY' END AS action_type, 'PRODUCTS' AS asset_type, holding_product.product_option_id AS product_option_id, product_transaction.amount AS action_amount, account.cash_balance AS current_cash, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(holding_security.quantity * holding_security.average_price) FROM holding_securities holding_security WHERE holding_security.account_id = account.account_id ), 0) AS current_stock_principal, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( CASE product.product_type WHEN 'DEPOSIT' THEN active_holding.join_amount ELSE active_holding.join_amount * COALESCE(active_holding.paid_installments, 0) END ) FROM holding_products active_holding JOIN product_options product_option ON product_option.product_option_id = active_holding.product_option_id JOIN products product ON product.product_id = product_option.product_id WHERE active_holding.account_id = account.account_id AND active_holding.status = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS current_deposit, COALESCE( product_transaction.terminated_at, product_transaction.created_at ) AS traded_at FROM product_transactions product_transaction JOIN holding_products holding_product ON holding_product.holding_product_id = product_transaction.holding_product_id JOIN accounts account ON account.account_id = holding_product.account_id WHERE account.user_id = #{userId} AND product_transaction.product_transaction_id = #{productTransactionId} AND product_transaction.status = 'COMPLETED' AND product_transaction.type IN ('SUBSCRIBE', 'TERMINATE', 'MATURITY')
